6
Mma ne Agyanom
1 # Kol 3.20 Mma, montie mo awofoɔ asɛm Awurade mu; na yei na ɛtene. 2#Eks 20.12 Di w’agya ne wo na ni! Yei ne mmara asɛm a ɛdi kan a bɔhyɛ wɔ mu, 3#Deut 5.16 na awie wo yie, na wo nna aware asase so. 4#Kol 3.21; Mmb 19.18; Deut 6.7; 6.20-25; Dwom 78.4 Na agyanom, monnhyɛ mo mma abufuo, na mmom montete wɔn Awurade kasakyerɛ ne nyansakyerɛ mu.
Nkoa
5 # Kol 3.22-25; Tito 2.9-10; 1 Pe 2.18 Nkoa, momfa suro ne ahopopoɔ ntie mo honam fam wuranom asɛm mfiri mo akoma mu, sɛdeɛ moyɛ ma Kristo, 6ɛnyɛ ani so som mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom sɛ Kristo nkoa a wɔfiri akoma mu yɛ Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ, 7na wɔde adwempa som sɛ wɔyɛ ma Awurade, na ɛnyɛ nnipa. 8#2 Ko 5.10 Na monim sɛ papa a obiara bɛyɛ no, akoa oo, ɔdehyeɛ oo, ɛno ara ho akatua na ɔbɛnya no wɔ Awurade nsam.
Awuranom
9 # Kol 4.1; 2 Be 19.7; Aso 10.34 Na awuranom, monyɛ saa ara nso mma wɔn, mommrɛ ateatea ase, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ wɔne mo ara nso wura wɔ soro, na nnipa animhwɛ biara nni ne fam.
Honhom fam atamfoɔ
10 # 1 Ko 16.13; 1 Yoh 2.14 Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, momma mo ho nyɛ den Awurade ne n’ahoɔden tumi mu. 11#2 Ko 10.4 Monhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodeɛ nyinaa, na moatumi agyina ne ɔbonsam nnɛɛdɛeɛ adi asie, 12#Yoh 14.30; Efe 2.2 ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ yɛne mogya ne honam na anya, na mmom yɛne mpaninnie ne tumidie ne wiase yi sum mu atumfoɔ ne ahonhommɔne a ɛwɔ soro hɔnom.
Onyankopɔn Akodeɛ
13Yei nti monhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodeɛ no nyinaa, na moatumi agyina ɛda bɔne no mu, na moyɛ ne nyinaa wie a, moagyina hɔ. 14#Luka 12.35; 1 Pe 1.13; 1 Te 5.8 Enti monnyina hɔ, momfa nokorɛ mmɔ mo asene, na monhyɛ tenenee nkataboɔ, 15na momfa asomdwoeɛ asɛmpa no ho ahodasoɔ nhyehyɛ mo nan, 16#1 Pe 5.9; 1 Yoh 5.4 ne nyinaa akyiri no, monkura gyidie kyɛm a mode bɛtumi adum ɔbɔnefoɔ no bɛmma a ɛredɛre no nyinaa, 17#1 Te 5.8 na momfa nkwagyeɛ dadeɛ kyɛ ne honhom nkrantɛ a ɛne Nyankopɔn asɛm, 18#Mat 26.41 na momfa mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ nyinaa mmɔ mpaeɛ daa honhom mu, na ɛno ara nti monwɛn, na montoa so ara nsrɛ mma ahotefoɔ nyinaa, 19#Kol 4.3; 2 Te 3.1; Aso 4.29 ɛne me nso, sɛ, mebue m’ano a, wɔmma me asɛm a menka, na memfa nnam menyi asɛmpa no ahuntasɛm menkyerɛ. 20#2 Ko 5.20 Ɛno ho bɔfoɔ na meyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu; na mayɛ mu nnam, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mekasa.
Nkradie
21 # Aso 20.4; 2 Ti 4.12 Na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mo nso moate me ho asɛm sɛdeɛ meteɛ no, onua dɔfo ne Awurade mu somfo nokwafoɔ Tihiko bɛma moahunu ne nyinaa. 22#Kol 4.7-8 Yei ara nti na masoma no mo nkyɛn, na moahunu sɛdeɛ yɛn ho teɛ, na wahyɛ mo akoma den.
23Asomdwoeɛ ne ɔdɔ ne gyidie nso a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka anuanom. 24Adom nka wɔn a wɔde ɔdɔ a ɛho nte kyema dɔ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo no nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Mma, montie mo awofoɔ asɛm Awurade mu; na yei na ɛtene. Di w’agya ne wo na ni! Yei ne mmara asɛm a ɛdi kan a bɔhyɛ wɔ mu, na awie wo yie, na wo nna aware asase so. Na agyanom, monnhyɛ mo mma abufuo, na mmom montete wɔn Awurade kasakyerɛ ne nyansakyerɛ mu.

Nkoa, momfa suro ne ahopopoɔ ntie mo honam fam wuranom asɛm mfiri mo akoma mu, sɛdeɛ moyɛ ma Kristo, ɛnyɛ ani so som mu, sɛ wɔn a wɔsɔ nnipa ani, na mmom sɛ Kristo nkoa a wɔfiri akoma mu yɛ Nyankopɔn apɛdeɛ, na wɔde adwempa som sɛ wɔyɛ ma Awurade, na ɛnyɛ nnipa. Na monim sɛ papa a obiara bɛyɛ no, akoa oo, ɔdehyeɛ oo, ɛno ara ho akatua na ɔbɛnya no wɔ Awurade nsam.

Na awuranom, monyɛ saa ara nso mma wɔn, mommrɛ ateatea ase, ɛfiri sɛ monim sɛ wɔne mo ara nso wura wɔ soro, na nnipa animhwɛ biara nni ne fam.

Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, momma mo ho nyɛ den Awurade ne n’ahoɔden tumi mu. Monhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodeɛ nyinaa, na moatumi agyina ne ɔbonsam nnɛɛdɛeɛ adi asie, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnyɛ yɛne mogya ne honam na anya, na mmom yɛne mpaninnie ne tumidie ne wiase yi sum mu atumfoɔ ne ahonhommɔne a ɛwɔ soro hɔnom.

Yei nti monhyɛ Nyankopɔn akodeɛ no nyinaa, na moatumi agyina ɛda bɔne no mu, na moyɛ ne nyinaa wie a, moagyina hɔ. Enti monnyina hɔ, momfa nokorɛ mmɔ mo asene, na monhyɛ tenenee nkataboɔ, na momfa asomdwoeɛ asɛmpa no ho ahodasoɔ nhyehyɛ mo nan, ne nyinaa akyiri no, monkura gyidie kyɛm a mode bɛtumi adum ɔbɔnefoɔ no bɛmma a ɛredɛre no nyinaa, na momfa nkwagyeɛ dadeɛ kyɛ ne honhom nkrantɛ a ɛne Nyankopɔn asɛm, na momfa mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ nyinaa mmɔ mpaeɛ daa honhom mu, na ɛno ara nti monwɛn, na montoa so ara nsrɛ mma ahotefoɔ nyinaa, ɛne me nso, sɛ, mebue m’ano a, wɔmma me asɛm a menka, na memfa nnam menyi asɛmpa no ahuntasɛm menkyerɛ. Ɛno ho bɔfoɔ na meyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu; na mayɛ mu nnam, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mekasa.

Na deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mo nso moate me ho asɛm sɛdeɛ meteɛ no, onua dɔfo ne Awurade mu somfo nokwafoɔ Tihiko bɛma moahunu ne nyinaa. Yei ara nti na masoma no mo nkyɛn, na moahunu sɛdeɛ yɛn ho teɛ, na wahyɛ mo akoma den.
Asomdwoeɛ ne ɔdɔ ne gyidie nso a ɛfiri Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka anuanom. Adom nka wɔn a wɔde ɔdɔ a ɛho nte kyema dɔ yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo no nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
